title: Sean McVay says he addressed Rams assistant coaches' behavior toward Eagles fans. 'We'll be better'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay says he addressed Rams assistant coaches' behavior toward Eagles fans. 'We'll be better'
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay said he spoke with his assistants after online videos appeared to show coaches taunting Eagles fans and making obscene gestures from a stadium booth.
